purpose: The DISCRIMINATING corpus. On evenly-spread data the MaxSumLog and MinEntropy penalties provably coincide (both peak at the balanced split and both grow with bin size), so GreedyMinEntropy is byte-identical to GreedyLogSum and MinEntropy to MaxLogSum. Uneven duplicate runs break that tie, which is what makes the border_types fixture non-vacuous for those two binarizers. See generator/gen_border_type_fixtures.py::runs_column.
